title: Prospective multicenter evaluation of a novel vertebral body replacement implant POSEIDON ST with 3D printed endplates
summary: Due to various diseases in the thoracolumbar (in the area of thoracic and lumbar spine) vertebral body replacement - implant (POSEIDON ST) is used, with the aim to restore the stability of your spine. the Poseidon ST is CE certified and therefore meets the requirements of all valid EU directives. It is officially approved on the market. The purpose of this study is to gain further clinical knowledge about the POSEIDON ST implant. However, the clinical outcomes, such as pain relief after surgery and osseous remodeling (fusion), have never been documented, analyzed and published in a structured way before. The aim of this study is to collect prospective clinical data to finally assess the clinical success and safety of the procedure.
conditions: Secondary malignant neoplasm of bone and bone marrow

interventions.name: Patients treated with a POSEIDON ST vertebral body replacement implant

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Inclusion criteria are the indication for surgical treatment with POSEIDON ST and the availability of a consent form. Only patients who have given their written consent to participate in accordance with data protection regulations will be included in the study.
Exclusion criteria:
- Age <18 years
- Participants unable to give consent, e.g. due to
cognitive impairments
- Pregnant women who are breastfeeding
- Patients for whom consent is not available
